title: Balsamic asparagus and green beans

items: 1 bunch asparagus (about 1 lb), woody ends snapped off

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F with a rack in the upper third. Pat the green beans and asparagus dry so they char instead of steam.
In a large bowl, toss the green beans with 1 Tbsp oil and half the salt. Spread them on a rimmed sheet pan in a single layer and roast 10 min.
While they roast, toss the asparagus in the same bowl with the remaining 1 Tbsp oil, the rest of the salt and the pepper.

Add the asparagus to the pan, toss with the beans and spread everything back into a single layer. Roast 10–12 min more, until both are tender-crisp and charred in spots. Pencil-thin asparagus may need only 8 min.
Move to a platter and drizzle with the balsamic glaze.
tips: Skillet version: heat 1 Tbsp oil in a 12-inch cast-iron skillet over high heat until it just smokes. Cook the green beans 5–6 min, add the asparagus and cook 4–5 min more, tossing now and then, until charred in spots. Work in batches if the pan is crowded.
No glaze: simmer ½ cup balsamic vinegar in a small pan over medium-low heat 8–10 min, until reduced by half. It thickens more as it cools.
storage: Fridge up to 3 days. Reheat in a hot skillet 2–3 min or eat at room temperature. Add a fresh drizzle of glaze after reheating.
